decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that captures every panel control assigned to an ESP32 GPIO; J_RESET uses EN-to-GND and BOOT has no GPIO assignment, so no edit is required.
The panel connector inventory and on-board BOOT-button placement do not change the selected ESP32-S3 module family, variant, or model.
The EN-to-GND entry concerns the panel reset button, not the 5V boost enable signal; the source does not change the boost rail's GPIO5 control or power behavior.
The listed panel buttons, touch inputs, reset connection, and BOOT-button placement do not alter the charge-status display or external charge-LED interface.
The source enumerates panel-control connectors and does not change either legacy interboard connector, its type, or its power and signal pinout.
Identifying the BOOT button as on-board for development use does not change the USB data routing, connector requirements, enumeration behavior, or USB-C programming-port role.
The panel-control connector list applies to the main-board controls and does not change the separate sensor board's connector-fanout role.
The source does not change the addressable LEDs' data GPIO, supply voltage, level shifting, or standby power control.
The panel-control connectors are unrelated to the battery NTC terminal, its connector, or AXP2101 thermal protection.
The source does not alter power-board battery connector placement, connector orientation, mounting-hole clearance, or physical accessibility.
The panel-control inventory does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, cable length, bus speed, or signal-conditioning topology.
The panel controls and BOOT-button placement do not change battery protection circuitry, cutoff voltages, or DW01A protection components.
